name: Tartan the Yellow-Tie Cat
blurb: Tartan, a sleek jet-black cat with round lemon-yellow eyes, wears a yellow plaid necktie and sits up straight on the sunny garden bench.

name: Inkwell the Black Necktie Cat
blurb: Inkwell, a slim glossy-black shorthair with bright yellow eyes, a yellow collar and a plaid tie, keeps a calm watch over the garden gate.

name: Mustard the Black Cat
blurb: Mustard, a small black cat with golden eyes, naps in the warm grass by the pond with his yellow plaid tie tugged loose after a long day.
